title: LilOS engine protocol
description: Generated from packages/contracts/src/engine by scripts/gen-schemas.ts — do not edit.

describe.doc: Handshake: protocol name/version plus the engine's capability descriptors.

session.start.doc: Create a session. mcpServers is the ACP shape; the LilOS MCP server rides in it.

prompt.doc: Send one user turn; resolves with the stop reason when the turn ends.

interrupt.doc: Abort the running turn; the pending prompt resolves with stopReason cancelled.

request.respond.doc: Answer an open approval/question from a request.opened event.

events.since.doc: Replay events after a seq watermark; returns a snapshot plus open requests.

session.stop.doc: Close the session; its event log stays replayable.

session.steer.doc: Inject text into the running turn: lands at the next tool boundary as turn.steered, or becomes the next turn's input when the turn ends first. not_running = nothing was consumed; send prompt instead.

agents.list.doc: List the engine's hireable agents (profiles) for the hire dialog.

agents.describe.doc: One agent's full descriptor, including its persona text.

agents.create.doc: Register a new agent profile on the engine. No delete exists by design.

models.list.doc: List the engine's selectable models for the model picker.

session.setModel.doc: Pin a model on a session; the next turn uses it (see turn.started.model).

session.setTitle.doc: Set the engine session's display title — the harness mirrors the app's rename so the engine's own lists stay consistent.

session.setHidden.doc: Move the engine session out of / back into its default list — the engine-side counterpart of archive/unarchive.

session.rewind.doc: Drop all user turns after `toTurn` from the session's context (issue #134). Refuses INVALID_STATE while a turn runs. Engines on transports without history rewind (ACP today) don't declare the capability.

event.doc: Engine -> client notification carrying a sequenced event frame.
